resources.string: Adds \"Send to Mirlo\" to the X app. Posts are queued in a folder that Syncthing carries to Mirlo-desktop.

1. In Syncthing, share a folder between this phone and ~/Mirlo/.inbox on your computer, as "Send & Receive" on both sides (so the phone learns what was saved).
2. Pick that same folder below.
3. Patch X with LSPatch and enable this module for it.

Each send leaves a small <ID>.mirlo file there. Mirlo-desktop picks it up within seconds when it is open, or the next time you open it. Without the module you can still use Share → Send to Mirlo.
That is not a link to a post on X
Could not write to the folder: %1$s
Mirlo lost access to the folder. Choose it again.
Remember to sync the posts you sent to Mirlo from the X/Twitter app with your computer, in case Syncthing does not start on the computer and the phone.

The question only shows on Wi-Fi. \"Apply\" starts Syncthing-Fork and waits until Mirlo-desktop saves the posts; for that, enable Settings › Behaviour › Service control by broadcast in Syncthing-Fork.
